task.title: Page available recurrence occurrences through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/949 to expose available occurrence evidence through a read-only deterministic adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity and page size before read-only storage access.
Emit authored-order available occurrences, exact revisions, release evidence, and kernel cursor.
Return stable diagnostics and no stdout for bounds, storage, replay, or corruption failures.

attempts.diagnostic: CLI integration tests failed because available was not a recognized recurrence subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the issue contract before completing the production boundary.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented read-only delegation, explicit available serialization, validation, typed diagnostics, integration tests, ADR-0077, and docs.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 949 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review found no blockers and CodeRabbit generated no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 949 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 950 exact head

lessons: Output projection may be explicit while cursor and lifecycle semantics remain kernel-owned.
Read-only evidence exposure must not create a durable cursor or ambient clock.
The adapter grants no claim-next, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
